exposure: duration of the active phase of the second stage of labour
total duration of the second stage of labour
cohort: The cohort consisted of nulliparous pregnant persons who gave birth to a singleton, non-anomalous, vertex foetus at >= 37 weeks' gestational age from 2017 to 2021.
finding: An increasing duration of the active phase of the second stage of labour is associated with an increased risk of Obstetrical Anal Sphincter Injury (OASI).
mod_finding: When stratified by mode of delivery (spontaneous, vacuum, forceps), the association between active phase duration and OASI risk was attenuated.
gest_age: At or above 37 weeks' gestational age
